audience: fire, life-safety and building-service contractors that run their work in ServiceTrade

useCases.title: Find overdue jobs and where they are
useCases.text: List the jobs by status and due date. Read the customer and location of each late job.

useCases.title: Review open deficiencies at a customer site
useCases.text: List the deficiencies with severity and status. Open one to read the asset and the job that reported it.

useCases.title: Check unpaid invoices of the last 30 days
useCases.text: List the invoices with status, due date and paid state. Open one to read its items and totals.

useCases.title: Plan a technician day
useCases.text: List the appointments with time window, job and location. Read the technician users and the jobs behind each visit.

useCases.title: Leave a note on a job or deficiency
useCases.text: Read the earlier comments on a record. Then add a new comment so the office team sees the context.
